stories.title: Mission blasts off for Mars to grab a piece of its moon
stories.brief: A spacecraft is set to launch on an ambitious mission to bring 10g of Martian moon dust back to Earth.

stories.title: Defamation tribunal orders Punjab Assembly opposition leader to pay Rs3m to Azma Bokhari
stories.brief: LAHORE: The Punjab Defamation Tribunal on Tuesday ruled in favour of Punjab Information Minister Azma Bokhari in a defamation suit against Punjab Assembly Opposition Leader Moeen Riaz Qureshi, ordering him to pay Rs3 million in general damages. In January, Bokhari filed the defamation suit against Qureshi seeking damages of Rs800 million.

stories.title: PHC issues notices in petitions challenging governor’s rule, emergency in KP; hearing adjourned till Nov 10
stories.brief: PESHAWAR: The Peshawar High Court (PHC) on Tuesday issued notices to the federal and Khyber Pakhtunkhwa governments in several petitions challenging the imposition of emergency and governor’s rule in the province on Oct 11.

stories.title: Punjab Information Minister Azma Bokhari wins Rs84m defamation case against opposition leader
stories.brief: Punjab Information Minister Azma Bokhari won a defamation case against Punjab Assembly Opposition Leader Moeen Riaz Qureshi on Tuesday, with the court ruling in her favour in an Rs84 million damages suit over allegations he made against her during a television programme.

stories.title: PHC seeks Centre’s response over imposition of emergency, governor’s rule in K-P
stories.brief: During the hearing, the petitioners’ counsel argued that the provincial government had not lost control of the province and that the imposition of emergency and governor’s rule amounted to an attack on provincial autonomy and democracy.

stories.title: Russia offers a diplomatic off-ramp in Pak-Afghan standoff
stories.brief: Russia on Monday offered to help defuse tensions between Pakistan and Afghanistan, signaling a potentially greater diplomatic role for Moscow at a time when relations between Islamabad and Kabul have deteriorated sharply over the issue of cross-border terrorism.

stories.title: PM asks FBR to plug tax gap amid pruning plans
stories.brief: The federal government on Monday dropped the idea of setting up a new tax agency but decided to compulsorily retire non-performing officers by amending the Civil Servants Act, which would allow it to retrench bureaucrats as part of any restructuring.
